verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a hosted email API that also ships a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to disable telemetry or analytics in the CLI, SDKs, MCP server, or console. The SOC 2 report and scoped API key permissions are adjacent security controls and do not count as a telemetry opt-out.
